description: baseline: naive full-state transfer across all 18 cells (3 topo × 3 J × 2 N)
attempt 1: topology-dispatched BF+RIBLT hybrid (Star/Tree eager-fwd, Chord ascending-power)
attempt 2: one-sketch-only for Star/Tree (eliminate redundant re-sketches via has_sketched flag)
attempt 3 (failed): asymmetric BF for all topologies — Chord worse (19%) due to stale-set cascades from request-response delay
attempt 4: asymmetric BF for Star/Tree only — lower-id sends sketch, higher-id sends request BF; Star/Tree -1-3%, Chord unchanged
attempt 5: suppress eager-forwarding to neighbours that already sent us the element (received_digests filter); Star/Tree -0.7%, Chord unchanged
attempt 6: Chord RIBLT(sender∩common, common) instead of RIBLT(sender_all, common) — diff shrinks from |local_only|+|FPs| to |FPs| only; Chord -32%, Star/Tree ~-1.5%, rounds 10→8 for Chord n=16
